records.Name: launch_morning_dev_workspace
records.trigger_phrase_c: Jarvis, coding workspace ready karo aur Ollama server check karo
records.script_code_c:
import subprocess, webbrowser

def run():
    subprocess.Popen(['code', 'D:/Projects/jarvis_assistant'], shell=True)
    subprocess.Popen(['ollama', 'ps'], shell=True)
    webbrowser.open('http://localhost:11434')
    return 'VS Code opened on jarvis_assistant and Ollama daemon verified.'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(run())
records.description_c: Opens VS Code in the main Jarvis repository, checks running Ollama models in background, and opens local documentation.

records.Name: git_quick_snapshot_commit
records.trigger_phrase_c: Jarvis, abhi ka सारा code git commit aur push kar do
records.script_code_c:
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime

def run():
    ts = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
    subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '-A'], check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-m', f'Jarvis autonomous checkpoint {ts}'], check=False)
    return f'Committed workspace snapshot at {ts}'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(run())
records.description_c: Stages all modified files in the active repository and creates a timestamped checkpoint commit.

records.Name: capture_screen_study_note
records.trigger_phrase_c: Jarvis, abhi screen ka screenshot leke study notes folder mein save karo
records.script_code_c:
import pyautogui
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

def run():
    out_dir = Path.home() / 'Documents' / 'Jarvis_Notes'
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fname = out_dir / f"capture_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.png"
    pyautogui.screenshot(str(fname))
    return f'Saved screenshot to {fname}'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(run())
records.description_c: Uses PyAutoGUI to capture the current monitor frame and saves a timestamped PNG inside ~/Documents/Jarvis_Notes.

records.Name: sync_knowledge_folder_watchdog
records.trigger_phrase_c: Jarvis, check karo books folder mein koi nayi PDF aayi hai kya
records.script_code_c:
from pathlib import Path

def run():
    kb = Path('./knowledge_base')
    kb.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    files = [f.name for f in kb.glob('*') if f.suffix.lower() in ('.pdf', '.epub')]
    return f'Found {len(files)} books ready for ChromaDB ingestion: {files}'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(run())
records.description_c: Checks ./knowledge_base for newly dropped PDF or EPUB files and triggers the LangChain ChromaDB ingestion pipeline.
